name: dRally
description:
dRally is an open-source source port of Death Rally (1996), the classic top-down vehicular combat and racing game developed by Remedy Entertainment. It allows fans to play the legendary action racer natively on modern operating systems.

Features:
- Native execution on modern operating systems with high-resolution scaling
- Preserves all original tracks, weapons, underground black market, and rivalries
- Supports smooth keyboard, gamepad, and custom controller input
- High-fidelity audio playback reproducing the energetic soundtrack and explosive sound effects
- Requires original Death Rally game data (including the free release)
